redeem.summary: Redeem a REX Premium, Priority or Ultra code for the server you run it in, or an XP code.
redeem.details: Premium-type codes start with REX-PREMIUM-, REX-PRIORITY- or REX-ULTRA-. Run the command inside the server you want to upgrade.
tips: Codes work for the server where you redeem them.
A code can be expired, deactivated or used up; REX tells you which.

premium.summary: Check Premium status or view the Premium feature list.
premium.details: Code generation, giveaways and removal inside this command are for REX owners only.

settings.details: The website dashboard covers the same settings with channel and role pickers.

ban.summary: Ban a member and record a moderation case.
tips: Cases can be looked up with /case and /history.

unban.summary: Unban a user by their Discord ID.

kick.summary: Kick a member from the server.

timeout.summary: Time a member out for a number of minutes.

un timeout.summary: Remove an active timeout from a member.

mass-timeout.summary: Time out several members at once (Premium).

warn.summary: Warn a member. Warnings are stored and can be reviewed later.
tips: View them with /warns, clear them with /clearwarns.

clearwarns.summary: Clear all warnings for a member.

case.summary: Look up one moderation case by its number.

history.summary: Show a member's recent moderation history.

notes.summary: Read the private staff notes on a member.

staffnote.summary: Add a private note about a member that only staff can read.

purge.summary: Delete a number of recent messages in the current channel.

slowmode.summary: Set the slowmode delay for the current channel, in seconds.

lock.summary: Lock a channel so members cannot send messages.

lockdown.summary: Lock every channel in the server until you run /unlockdown.
tips: Use /unlockdown to reopen the channels that /lockdown closed.

quarantine.summary: Remove all roles REX can manage from a member, to contain a compromised or risky account.

temprole.summary: Give a member a role that is removed automatically after a set time.

report.summary: Report a member to the server staff.
report.details: Reports go to the report channel the server has configured.

ticket.summary: Create and manage the ticket system.
tips: Set the ticket category, panel title and welcome message from the dashboard.

ticket-action.summary: Manage the ticket you are in with one action menu.

tips: Changing the counting channel on the dashboard resets the count to 0.

announcement.summary: Send an announcement to a channel of your choice.

level.summary: Show your animated level card, or someone else's.

leaderboard.summary: Show the XP leaderboard for the server.

tips: The website Profile page shows your levels and coins across servers.

giveaway.summary: Start a giveaway with a duration, number of winners and a prize.

rps.summary: Play rock paper scissors against another member.

choose.summary: Let REX pick between options you give it.

serverinfo.summary: Show server information with buttons for channel and role detail.

userinfo.summary: Show information about a user, including their avatar.

reminder.summary: Set a reminder for a number of minutes from now.

afk.summary: Mark yourself AFK with an optional reason.

timezone.summary: Set your timezone preference for REX.

custom-command.summary: Create server-specific slash commands that reply with text or embeds (Premium).
tips: Custom commands only exist in your server, so they are not in this directory.
